title: 7-month-old boy with a cough
arrival: A 7-month-old boy is brought in by his mother with a cough for three days.
keyCriterion: No red, yellow, or high-risk vital sign criteria met
feedbackWhy: This patient does not meet any red or yellow criteria and has no high-risk vital signs. At 7 months he is outside the 8 days to 6 months age band, so his age alone does not meet a yellow criterion. He can safely wait for evaluation in the low-acuity area.
reassessment: As with all patients in the waiting area, he should undergo reassessment because his condition can change while waiting. His caregiver should be advised to notify staff if his symptoms worsen.
reviewNote: CLINICIAN REVIEW REQUIRED: confirm the age boundary, that 7 months is clearly outside '8 days to 6 months'. Age band under 1 year (HR 90-180, RR 25-50). Every value is proposed.

design.intendedChallenge: Green is reached only after every part of the card has been checked. A 7-month-old is just outside the 8 days to 6 months age band, so age alone does not meet a yellow criterion.
design.expectedCommonError: triaging as yellow because he is a young infant.

unresponsive.text: Awake. Looks around and follows his mother with his eyes.

airway_red.text: Occasional cough. No stridor. No chest indrawing. No central cyanosis.

circulation_red.text: Pulse strong. Extremities warm. Capillary refill 2 seconds. No bleeding. Awake and interacting. Eyes not sunken. Skin pinch returns at once. Feeding normally.

disability_red.text: No convulsions. Awake and interacting. Not confused, restless or irritable. No stiff neck.

other_red.text: Age 7 months. No trauma, poisoning, threatened limb or snake bite.

airway_yellow.text: No swelling of the mouth, throat or neck. No wheezing.

circulation_yellow.text: Feeding normally. No vomiting or diarrhoea. Not pale. Mouth moist.

disability_yellow.text: Awake and interacting. Not restless or irritable. No severe pain.

other_yellow.text: Age 7 months. No visible wasting. No swelling of both feet. No rash. No trauma. No known surgical diagnosis.
